comment: Modularity is defined mainly through component independence. However, independently deployable components can still be tightly coupled through shared databases, proprietary data models, coordinated release cycles, or undocumented dependencies.

anchor.note: p.33 l.Lines 286-300 read as the printed page; section 2.3 agrees

public.text: Modularity is defined mainly through component independence. However, independently deployable components can still be tightly coupled through shared databases, proprietary data models, coordinated release cycles, or undocumented dependencies.
public.suggestedRevision: Expand the test for modularity to include independent data ownership, explicit API contracts, version compatibility, no mandatory shared database, documented dependencies, and independent replacement or upgrade.
